author: Seung Wook
problem: readings are a barometer's hourly air-pressure readings in hPa. Return the largest change between two consecutive readings in either direction, or 0 if there are fewer than two readings.
bug_description: Takes after - before without abs(), so drops in pressure are never counted and only the biggest rise is found.

comments.accurate: Largest hour-to-hour change in pressure, up or down
comments.wrong_behavior: Largest hour-to-hour rise in pressure seen in the readings
comments.wrong_location: Change calculation verified; check each reading is paired with the next one
